# Donexia — NGO CRM for Indian NGOs

Donexia is donation and donor management software (NGO CRM) built for Indian nonprofits.
It covers donation management, donor records, volunteer management, campaign management,
activities management, audit-ready reports, and automatic donation receipts sent to donors
via WhatsApp, SMS and email, with integrated payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Instamojo)
for online donations and shareable payment links.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://donexia.in/): NGO donation management software overview
- [Pricing](https://donexia.in/pricing.html): free forever plan + paid plans from ₹4,999/month
